summary: Prince of Persia entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Prince Of Persia The Lost Crown

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows version rather than emulation; Windows 10/11 is supported, with an unlocked frame-rate ceiling.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC at 4K Ultra and beyond-120-FPS output if hardware and display allow.

primary.why: Windows is the best primary because it targets 4K Ultra on PC, with an unlocked frame rate that can extend beyond 120 FPS, and the Complete Edition bundles the base game with Mask of Darkness story DLC plus bonus content. The console, macOS, and mobile releases are valid, but none exceeds the PC fidelity ceiling while also packaging the complete content set as cleanly.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Complete Edition on Windows 10/11, target 4K Ultra or higher-refresh output as hardware allows, use a controller for precision platforming, and play Mask of Darkness after reaching its in-game access point.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not a remaster. The important version note is content packaging: choose Complete Edition so Mask of Darkness story DLC and bonus content are included with the main game.

entries.title: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; use console emulation only for platform comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC original at modern capture settings

primary.why: The original PC version has the strongest native capture/settings route among released versions. Console versions remain useful for controller-authentic comparison, but no platform-exclusive story route is sourced.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC version with modern compatibility fixes as needed. Use GameCube/PS2/Xbox only for controller or original-console comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not rely on unreleased remake plans for the archive route. Use the released original PC version.

entries.title: Prince of Persia: Warrior Within
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC main run plus Xbox exclusive modes if completeness matters

emulation.emulator: Not required for primary; Xemu/real Xbox only for exclusive modes if legal and verified
emulation.notes: Use native PC for main route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC with modern fixes plus Xbox secondary content

primary.why: PC is the best normal fidelity/capture route for Warrior Within, but the PC version is missing Xbox-exclusive Time Attack and Arena Combat modes with unique levels. Use PC for the main run and Xbox only for those exclusive modes if completeness matters.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC version from Steam/GOG or original media with known community fixes. Record storefront/build, widescreen/controller fixes, audio behavior, ending route, and whether Xbox exclusive modes were separately checked.

secondary.exclusive_content: Time Attack and Arena Combat modes with unique levels.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the Xbox-exclusive Time Attack and Arena Combat content after the PC main run.
secondary.why: These modes are absent from the PC version.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document compatibility fixes and the Xbox-only Time Attack/Arena Combat secondary plan.

entries.title: Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC main run; PSP Rival Swords only for targeted exclusive-content comparison

emulation.emulator: Not required for primary; PPSSPP only for PSP secondary content if legal and verified
emulation.notes: Use native PC for the main route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC with modern fixes plus PSP secondary content where verified

primary.why: PC is the best capture/fidelity route for the main Two Thrones release. Rival Swords is a later Wii/PSP route with platform-specific changes and PSP local multiplayer/added content, so preserve that only as a secondary comparison route if completeness requires it.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC version from Ubisoft/Steam or original media with known community compatibility fixes. Record storefront/build, widescreen/controller fixes, ending route, and whether PSP Rival Swords content was separately checked.

secondary.exclusive_content: PSP version includes local multiplayer and added single-player content.
secondary.what_to_play: Inspect only the PSP-exclusive Rival Swords material after the PC main run if completeness matters.
secondary.why: The PC version remains the fidelity route, while PSP content is a targeted secondary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document compatibility fixes and whether Rival Swords PSP content was inspected.

entries.title: Prince of Persia 2: The Shadow and the Flame
entries.definitive_edition: Macintosh original for highest original fidelity, with DOS practical route and mobile remake documented separately

emulation.emulator: SheepShaver/Basilisk II for Mac route; DOSBox for DOS route
emulation.notes: Use original media/assets where possible and document exact platform.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Macintosh high-resolution release for the 1993 game

primary.version: Original 1993 game, Macintosh high-resolution route documented against DOS
primary.why: The Macintosh version has higher-resolution graphics than DOS/SNES, while the DOS route is the most common PC access point. The 2013 mobile remake is a separate reinterpretation and has availability caveats.
primary.how_to_play: Use a documented Macintosh route for highest original-version fidelity, or DOS/GOG-compatible assets for practical PC access. Record platform, emulator/wrapper, resolution, input, audio, difficulty, completion route, and whether the 2013 mobile remake was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Common original PC and console routes
secondary.what_to_play: Use for DOS/SNES comparison and practical access.
secondary.why: Mac has the high-resolution original route, but DOS/SNES are important versions.
It is a remake and not the original 1993 game route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether the run is original DOS/Mac/SNES or the 2013 mobile remake; do not merge remake completion with the original.

entries.title: Prince of Persia: The Forgotten Sands
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version for the HD branch; Wii/portable versions separately if needed

emulation.notes: Native PC route is preferred; Wii/portable emulation only for distinct-version comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current/owned PC HD branch with settings and DRM state documented

primary.version: PC/PS3/Xbox 360 version via current PC route if available
primary.why: The Forgotten Sands is a set of distinct 2010 versions; Windows, PS3, and Xbox 360 share the main HD branch, while Wii, PSP, DS, mobile, and browser versions are different games or adaptations. PC is the preferred capture route when an owned/current copy is available.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC version through Steam/Ubisoft Connect or an owned copy. Record storefront, Ubisoft Connect/login state, patch, graphics settings, controller, difficulty, collectibles/challenge mode, DRM behavior, and whether the distinct Wii/PSP/DS/mobile versions were sampled separately.

secondary.exclusive_content: Distinct version with different structure, powers, and content
secondary.what_to_play: Archive separately if version-complete coverage matters.
secondary.why: It is not the same game as the PC/PS3/Xbox 360 branch.
The main archive route is the HD branch.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record Ubisoft Connect/DRM state and selected version branch.

entries.title: Prince of Persia 3D
entries.definitive_edition: Original Windows PC release with compatibility fixes documented

emulation.notes: Use native Windows compatibility fixes; Dreamcast emulation only for comparison.

primary.version: Original Prince of Persia 3D PC release with compatibility fixes
primary.why: Prince of Persia 3D is the third main Prince of Persia game before the Sands of Time era. The Windows PC release is the original route and best capture target if compatibility is handled; the Dreamcast version, Arabian Nights, is a separate console adaptation with changes.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Windows PC copy with compatibility fixes. Record OS, patch/fix state, resolution, controls, difficulty, level, save state, and whether Dreamcast Arabian Nights was compared.

secondary.platform: Dreamcast - Prince of Persia: Arabian Nights
secondary.exclusive_content: Console adaptation with changed title and version differences
secondary.why: It is not the same primary PC route and should be logged separately if sampled.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge Dreamcast Arabian Nights progress with the PC route; log controls and compatibility fixes.
